source.name: Footy Headlines – Al-Kholood 26-27 Home & Away Kits Released
source.quote: white Kappa Omini logos positioned on the chest and shoulders alongside the circular Al Kholood club badge
source.note: Kit supplier, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The launch write-up describes the whole home shirt – base colour, tonal graphic, white trim on the V-neck collar and sleeve cuffs, the Kappa Omini logos on chest and shoulders and the club badge – and nothing else: no commercial sponsor on any placement, and the launch photos show the same. The club's own store page for the players' home jersey 26/27 (https://alkholoodstore.com/products/al-kholood-fc-home-jersey-202526-2, undated, opened 2026-10-03) likewise lists the shirt's only marks: 'شعار البرج على الصدر، وشعار Kappa على الصدر والأكمام' ('the tower crest on the chest, and the Kappa logo on the chest and sleeves') plus a '1970' shield inside the collar and at the top of the back; its product photos show no sponsor logo on front or back. The Saudi Pro League's 'Fresh Fit: Kits of 2026-27 RSL' gallery (https://www.spl.com.sa/en/galleries/fresh-fits-kits-of-the-2026-27-rsl) shows the same sponsor-free shirts in its Al Kholood launch photo. Footy Headlines' article calls the deep-red zig-zag shirt the home one and the cream shirt with green raglan sleeves the away one; the club's own store and launch graphics call the cream shirt the home kit and the red one the reserve kit (الطقم الأساسي vs الطقم الاحتياطي). 433FC's pre-season table (https://433fc.com/saudi-pro-league-2026-27-shirt-sponsors/, 2026-06-15) lists 'Yelo Rent a Car' as main shirt sponsor, but it states its details 'reflect confirmed 2025/26 contracts carrying into 2026/27', and no 2026-27 shirt (launch, store or league gallery) shows any sponsor logo.

summary: Kappa home kit (the cream shirt with dark-green raglan sleeves and polo collar per the club's store; Footy Headlines' launch write-up swaps the home/reserve labels). No commercial shirt sponsor on any placement – front, back, sleeves and shorts carry only the club crest, the Kappa Omini and the 1970 collar shield – as launched in August 2026 and as sold in the club's own store.
headline: The shirt is {level}: it carries no commercial sponsors. Kappa makes the kit.
